en: \rKahili: The wind seems to be blowing in your favor today.
\rKahili: The wind seems to be blowing in my favor today.
\bHala: Oh ho ho! If it isn't \PN! Old Hala's gonna make you holler!
\bHala: Dahahaha! Well played! You're certainly a fine Trainer with fine Pokémon!
\bHala: Don't underestimate the strength of a kahuna!
\bHau: I'm not gonna let this end the same way it ended in the Alola League!
\bHau: That was amazing! I'll be rooting for you, \PN!
\bHau: That was amazing! Root for me, ok?
\rLillie: Hi \PN! I guess we have to battle, since we're here.
\rLillie: Hehe, that was a fun battle!
\rLillie: Hehe, that was a fun battle! Didn't expect to win, either!
\rLusamine: Ah, \PN. It's nice that we get to battle each other when there's no world-ending stakes to fight for.
\rLusamine: That was still a great battle. You're certainly the person that saved me back in Ultra Space.
\rLusamine: That was a great battle. Looks like I've grown a lot stronger since I was stuck in Ultra Space.
\bGuzma: \PN! I'm gonna beat you down until there's nothing's left! Big bad Guzma is here!
\bGuzma: Tch. I'll beat you down properly next time.
\bGuzma: Haha! That's all you've got? I was gonna destroy even more!
\bRyuki: YO! I'll show you that I'm as good, if not better than a real gym leader!
\bRyuki: My babies won't lose to you next time!
\bRyuki: See that! I'm gonna rock this place!
\bEmmet: I am Emmet. I am a Subway Boss. And I like winning more than anything else. So let's start a great battle in which every Pokémon uses various moves!
\bEmmet: I am Emmet. I lost against you. Because you are the strongest Trainer I've fought lately!
\bEmmet: I am Emmet. I won against you. But I think I just got lucky.
\bIngo: I am the Subway Boss Ingo. Will you go on to victory or defeat? All aboard!
\bIngo: Bravo!! Your talent has brought you to the destination called Victory!
\bIngo: Ah. Your battle was not bad at all. However, we seem to have done slightly better than you.
\bNoland: Hey, hey! How's it going? You keeping up with your studies? ...Oh? You've taken on a harder look than the last time I saw you. All right! Bring it on!
\bNoland: Way to work! That was a good lesson, eh? You keep up your studies!
\bNoland: Heh... You're a pretty bright spark... Next time, I'll come after you hard. No holds barred, understand? You keep up your studies!
\rGreta: Hey! Howdy! I was really looking forward to seeing you again! I won't allow a halfhearted effort! Let's get this started!
\rGreta: Arrrgh! This is so infuriating! If we ever battle again, I won't lose! Don't you forget it! Bye-bye!
\rGreta: Heheh! What did you expect? You have to try harder than that!
\bTucker: Ah... The pummeling roar of the crowd... Their furnace-like heat of excitement... This is a wonderful place... Let the battle begin!
\bTucker: You're genuinely fantastic! I will very much look forward to our next encounter!
\bTucker: Ahahaha! Aren't you embarrassed? Everyone's watching!
\rLucy: You again... I've trampled flowers and braved storms to get to where I am... I don't feel any compulsion to keep losing to the same opponent. Now! Come on!
\rLucy: Urk... That's all there is... Disappear already...
\rLucy: Humph... Your luck ran out before this battle.
\bSpenser: Gwahahah! This time, I won't bluster or hold back. Ready now? Prepare to lose! Kaaah!
\bSpenser: Gwahahah! My brethren and I will be eagerly awaiting the next opportunity to see you!
\bSpenser: Gwahahaha! My brethren, we have nothing to fear!
\rAnabel: Fufu... I won't have to hold back against you... It's been too long since I've been able to battle without thinking about anything... Let's begin, shall we?
\rAnabel: Fufu, congratulations... I have never had a Pokémon battle so enjoyable before... I wish I could battle with you again...
\rAnabel: I'm very sorry... That was disappointing.
\bBrandon: Ah, \PN. You did well to beat me last time. Now then, bring me everything you have! I'm braced for it all!
\bBrandon: That's it! You've done it! You kept working for this!
\bBrandon: Hey! Don't give up now! Get up! Don't lose faith in yourself!
\bPalmer: Hi \PN! Show me the bond you've built with your Pokémon. Show me what you've learned through battles with Trainers!
\bPalmer: A magnificent bout that was! Let's battle again!
\bMilo: Ah, it's \PN! I've heard many things about you. My name's Milo, and I'm quite partial to Grass-type Pokémon. This'll be a real doozy of a battle!
\bMilo: That must have been a fulfilling Pokémon battle for you! Until next time!
\bMilo: Don't underestimate the power of Grass! Until next time!
\rNessa: Well, if it isn't the famous \PN. I'm Nessa. I love fishing, but I love Pokémon battles even more and I'm itching for a battle with you!
\rNessa: How...? How can this be?! *sigh* Now that I've battled you, I think I understand. Keep going, \PN.
\rNessa: What did you think of our graceful Water-type moves? I've worked to refine them to their purest form, y'know.
\bKabu: Oh, it's \PN. I am Kabu. You've got to remember that in the end, the match is decided by which side is able to unleash their true potential. Show me what you've got!
\bKabu: Clearly, your talent surpassed my many years of experience. I still have much to learn!
\bKabu: That last battle raged hotter than even flames! But you'll need to burn even brighter to beat me!
\rBea: Trainer of Pikachu. I've trained hard for this rematch.
\rBea: I will continue to train.
\bAllister: R-Ready.
\bAllister: U-Until next time.
\rOpal: Oh? Ready for another quiz?
\rOpal: I've grown tired. Leave.
\rOpal: You need to appreciate pink more.

\bGordie: Hey there. The name's Gordie. I admit I feel a little bad for doing this to you, but... I'm going to use this match to show the crowd that my Pokémon are unbeatable! So, let's get this over with!
\bGordie: That was... impressive. I just need to train harder, that's all.
\bGordie: Well, you conducted yourself just as I would have expected, \PN. All it takes is one pitfall for a battle to end in disaster, and that's what happened here.
\rMelony: Hey \PN. I am Melony. I think you'll find my battle style is quite severe. You won't be able to escape when I freeze you solid!
\rMelony: \PN... You're pretty good, huh? Of course, seeing my Pokémon lose is sad, but to meet someone so young with such ability is quite grand. Well done!
\rMelony: You know, I can bring the temperature down even lower. Until next time.
\bPiers: This crowd... I'll get the audience pumped up, even without usin' Dynamax!
\bPiers: That's it?! Piers doesn't do encores, but I admit I'm tempted right now!
\bRaihan: Finally! I've been waiting for someone strong to battle, but I didn't think it would be you, \PN! Let's bring the storm!
\bRaihan: I might have lost, but I still look good. Maybe I should snap a quick selfie...
\bRaihan: That was a great victory. Time for a great selfie!
\bHop: \PN! I'll defeat you for my brother Leon!
\bHop: Dang... I didn't know you were this strong!
\bHop: Now Leon has one less worry!
\rMarnie: Glad you could make it without any trouble, \PN. Let's battle!
